name: Hope Oracle Mystery
body:
Class Skills: An oracle with the hope mystery adds Bluff, Knowledge (local), and Perception to her list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: 2nd-lesser good hope, 4th-encouragement, 6th–good hope, 8th-greater path of glory, 10th-shining beacon, 12th-greater good hope, 14th-hymn of peace, 16th–euphoric tranquility, 18th-beacon of life

Revelations: An oracle with the hope mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Calming Words (Ex)

You gain a +4 bonus on Diplomacy checks to alleviate despair or improve disposition. You may alleviate despair (See New Skill Uses on page 43 of this book) on two targets in a single standard action. Additionally you may use Diplomacy to alleviate despair on yourself.

Channel (Su)

You can channel positive energy like a cleric, using your oracle level as your effective cleric level when determining the amount of damage healed. This channeling cannot be used to harm undead. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier.

Guarded Resolve (Ex)

You gain a +4 bonus on saving throws against fear and despair effects and the DC to use Intimidation to demoralize or induce despair (See New Skill Uses on page 43 of this book) is increased by 4 for you. At 12th level, this bonus extends to any allies within 10 feet.

Healing Hopes (Su)

When you cast a spell with the hope descriptor you may heal one of the affected spell targets per 5 levels (minimum 1). The healing is equal to 1d8 plus the morale bonus provided for spells up to 3rd level, 2d8 plus the morale bonus provided for spells from 4th to 6th level, and 3d8 plus the morale bonus for spells from 7th to 9th levels. This healing does not affect non-living creatures but it does not harm undead. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 5th level, and every five levels thereafter.

Keeper of Hope (Su)

As a move action, you can call upon an inner reserve of resolve. You gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, and Will saves against fear and despair for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma bonus. At 7th level, this bonus increases to +2, and at 14th level this bonus increases to +3. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 5th level, and every five levels thereafter.

Providing Hope (Ex)

You are adept at boosting the hopes of your allies by defending them or bolstering them in their endeavors. You gain Bodyguard as a bonus feat and whenever you use the aid another action, the bonus you provide is increased by 1. This bonus increases by 1 at 4th level and every 5 oracle levels thereafter (to a maximum of +5 at 19th level).

This bonus does not stack with other feats or other abilities that improve the bonus you provide when using the aid another action. This revelation also counts as the Combat Expertise feat, but only for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of the Swift Aid feat and any feat that lists Swift Aid as a prerequisite.

Never Give Up (Ex)

Your inner resolve and hope keeps you going even in the darkest times. You gain the Endurance feat. At 7th level you gain the Diehard feat.

At 15th level you also gain Heroic Defiance feat. You do not need to meet the prerequisites of these bonus feats.

Rallying Cry (Ex)

As a standard action, you can let out a rallying cry. All allies within 100 feet that can hear your call gain the benefits of lesser heroism for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier. At 10th level, this increases to heroism. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 5th level and for every five levels thereafter.

Shared Fates (Su)

As a standard action, you may create a bond between yourself and an ally. Each round at the start of your turn, if the bonded ally is wounded for 5 or more hit points below its maximum hit points, it heals 5 hit points and you take 5 hit points of damage. You may have one bond active per oracle level.

This bond continues until the bonded ally dies, you die, the distance between you and your ally exceeds medium range, or you end it as an immediate action (if you have multiple bonds active, you may end as many as you want as part of the same immediate action).

Soaring Beacon (Su)

As a swift action, you can manifest a luminous glow that grants you a fly speed of 60 feet with an average maneuverability and a +4 bonus on Diplomacy checks.

Additionally you put out a light that illuminates with bright light out to 15 feet and dim light out to 30 feet. At 10th level, your speed increases to 90 feet, your maneuverability increases to good, and the bonus increases to +8 on Diplomacy checks. You can use this floating light for 1 minute per day per oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Final Revelation (Su)

At 20th level, you become a living beacon of hope exuding an aura of hope out to 30 feet. Any spell with the despair descriptor cast within the aura requires a concentration check as if the caster was defensively casting. Any spell with the hope descriptor cast within the aura is automatically extended per the metamagic feat without increasing the spell level. This extension does not stack with an application of the metamagic feat. Finally, each round you may dispel any despair effect within the aura as per the spell dispel magic as a free action.
